messages:
jordan: quick question — onboarding for AcmeCorp POC. They're testing streaming SSE with tool-calls and want telemetry: per-request token cost breakdown, per-conn latency, and can we rotate ephemeral creds for their edge adaptor? Also security wants SOC2 + KMS note. Any blockers for onprem pilot?

cara: short: all doable. On ephemeral creds: yes, short-lived STS tokens supported for Dedicated/private. For Hosted we support delegated tokens + short TTL via pre-signed sessions. For edge adaptor, we usually recommend client side certs + token rotation. Need to confirm with infra for KMS export policy. tagging @linus for exact runbook.

linus: notes: for streaming + function calls, watch out for large tool payloads — default max frame is 1MB. Batch size influences latency; we recommend `batch_size=4` for low-latency POCs. Telemetry: we emit per-request token counts and model latency in logs (redwood.telemetry). You can query via Console > Requests. If you want programmatic export, use the telemetry API (alpha). Example curl: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/telemetry/requests?from=...&to=...'```

eva: security Q: they need an encrypted-at-rest proof and KMS key rotation schedule. We need SOC2 attestation + A.3 encryption docs. I can attach our standard security pack. Also, for onprem, we support customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own).

jordan: Perfect. Pricing question from procurement: POC expected 500k tokens/month streaming with some streaming toolcalls — what's the right pricing or estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted? They prefer predictable cost.

linus: quick calc: hosted: ~ $0.02 per 1k tokens (example placeholder) — but for 500k tokens Hosted is fine. If they'd like cost predictability and dedicated throughput with <50ms p99, recommend a small Dedicated reservation. I'll DM ops for quote. For batching tips: enable KV caching for repeated prefixes; that can cut tokens by ~30%.

infra-bot: Deploy job 8823: watchman-agent started in us-east-1 for dedicated-demo. Status: success :white_check_mark:

cara: Action items: 1) @linus to get Dedicated quote + batch/cache config 2) @eva send security pack + KMS config 3) @jordan schedule POC kickoff with customer for Tue 11am EST 4) I'll add short runbook for ephemeral creds rotation into the handoff doc. :thumbsup:

jordan: Added kickoff, sent invite. One more ask: customer wants a short sample showing stream with function calls returning structured JSON and fallback to text. Can someone paste minimal example?

linus: quick snippet (node): ```js
// connect SSE
const s = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=gpt-4s');
s.onmessage = (e)=>{ const msg = JSON.parse(e.data); if(msg.type==='tool_call'){ fetch('/tool', {method:'POST', body:JSON.stringify(msg)}).then(r=>r.json()).then(res=>{/* send back via client callback */}); } else console.log(msg.text); }```

eva: I'll send security pack now. attaching: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (uploaded to file-store) and KMS_integration.md

jordan: Thanks team. I'll loop procurement and send the sample to Acme. Keeping thread open for ops quote.
